# VOXELMAP production wire fixture

`voxelmap_frame.bin` is an unmodified, 3801-byte outer Zenith frame including
CRC, copied from `驭空III/.codex_work/super_map_fix_20260827/wire-test/voxelmap_frame.bin`.
SHA-256: `F4B5F52ADB814E05C5798BB2E3803F888FD7A4CDD56EF6629273CB2720FDD7C5`.

The integration owner captured the actual ARM64 production bridge
`sendVoxelMapMsgPack` output (commit `4ca2478`, encoding introduced in `0f95882`) using saved ROG `/occ` data,
an isolated private ROS master at `http://127.0.0.1:11471`, and PTY `/dev/pts/0`.
This is **not a real radio capture or a flight validation**. The fixture is not
generated by the Qt tests. No ROS or transport is opened when replaying it.

The accompanying source `wire_report.json` reports 10576 input points,
894 occupied XY columns, 757 columns with multiple layers, and 3874 occupied
voxels. Frame ID is 698594355; dimensions are 133 x 133 x 24, XY/Z resolution
0.15 m, XY origin (-10.05, -10.05) m, and Z minimum -0.6 m. It is one RLE part
(encoding 1), using MsgId 13 and keys 80..92. The integration owner separately
compared every decoded column mask against NumPy output.

`voxelmap_production_wire` reuses the production C++ stream/MsgPack decoder,
TelemetryStore reassembly and VoxelInstanceTable. It checks 3874 instances,
then replays the same bytes in 37-byte fragments and verifies atomic publication
and identical masks/instances. Synthetic malformed/boundary tests are separate.

Manual offline replay (Qt and MinGW DLL directories must be on PATH):

```powershell
$env:QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING = '1'
.\build-release\VoxelInstanceTableTests.exe --wire-fixture .\tests\fixtures\voxelmap_frame.bin 3874
```
